summary: Five criminal cases were filed at the Fairbanks court on Wednesday, among them a domestic violence assault case against a Fairbanks man and the case against the North Pole man arrested by troopers on Tuesday, who was arraigned Wednesday afternoon on three counts. Troopers also reported a domestic violence assault arrest in the Kale Lane area of Fairbanks on Wednesday morning. Ten of the twelve open cases that carried a hearing on Wednesday produced a result. Fairbanks Police added rows to their daily bulletin for Sunday, Monday and Tuesday, including a hit and run on Old Richardson Highway and a violation of a domestic violence protective order on Mercier Street. The court's weekly criminal filings report, covering Oct. 28 to Nov. 3, lists 38 cases filed at Fairbanks, four at Nenana, two at Delta Junction and none at Healy; it does not list one case that carries a Tuesday filing date, so the court filed at least one case inside the report's window that the report omits. The court's weekly report of cases disposed has not been updated since Nov. 2.

entries.title: Domestic violence assault charges: Danny Wayne Adams
body: Danny Wayne Adams is charged with assault in the fourth degree — recklessly causing physical injury to another person — and with assault committed when a child was present, both Class A misdemeanors. The court records both counts as domestic violence related.
The offense is recorded at Fairbanks on Nov. 4. The case was filed the same day and he was arraigned that afternoon, when the court entered release conditions and appointed counsel.
Case 4FA-26-02228CR; pre-trial conference Dec. 24.

entries.title: Domestic violence assault arrest in the Kale Lane area
body: A person was arrested on what troopers record as assault in the fourth degree, domestic violence. No charge classification is given by the trooper dispatch.

Troopers say they responded to a report of domestic violence in the area of Kale Lane on Nov. 4, that an assault was found to have taken place, and that the suspect was taken into custody and remanded to the Fairbanks Correctional Facility. They say the investigation is continuing. The dispatch names no one.
Alaska State Troopers, case AK26109071.

sources.label: Alaska State Troopers daily dispatch, Nov. 4

entries.title: DUI charge: Robert Stephen Markle
body: Robert Stephen Markle is charged with driving under the influence with a blood alcohol level of .08 percent or more — driving with a blood alcohol level at or above the legal limit — a Class A misdemeanor.
The offense is recorded at Fairbanks on Nov. 3. The case was filed Nov. 4 and he was released under the court's bail schedule.
Case 4FA-26-02225CR; arraignment Nov. 10.

entries.title: Driving with a revoked license: Jonah Noah Tritt
body: Jonah Noah Tritt is charged with driving while his license was canceled, revoked or suspended after a previous conviction, a Class A misdemeanor.
The offense is recorded at Fairbanks on Oct. 13. The case carries a filing date of Nov. 3 and was opened on a requested summons; no arrest is recorded.
Case 4FA-26-02226CR; no court date is set.

entries.title: Driving with a revoked license: Hunter James Hughes
body: Hunter James Hughes is charged with driving while his license was canceled, revoked or suspended after a previous conviction, a Class A misdemeanor.
The offense is recorded at North Pole on Nov. 3. The case was filed Nov. 4 on a dated citation.
Case 4FA-26-02229CR; no court date is set.

entries.title: Hit and run on Old Richardson Highway
body: Fairbanks Police recorded a hit and run at the 800 block of Old Richardson Highway. No charge classification is given.
The bulletin entry covers a period from 9:30 a.m. on Nov. 2 to 8:06 a.m. on Nov. 3, when it was reported. No one is named.
Fairbanks Police, case 26003358.

entries.title: Violation of a domestic violence protective order on Mercier Street
body: Fairbanks Police recorded a violation of a domestic violence protective order at the 2500 block of Mercier Street. No charge classification is given.
Reported at 4:40 p.m. on Nov. 2. No one is named on the bulletin entry.
Fairbanks Police, case 26003351.

entries.title: Two warrant arrests in Fairbanks
body: Fairbanks Police recorded two warrant arrests on Nov. 3: one at the 3600 block of Airport Way, reported at 4:42 p.m., and one at the 500 block of Cushman Street, reported at 6:24 p.m.
Neither bulletin entry names anyone and neither states the charge behind the warrant.
Fairbanks Police, cases 26003362 and 26003363.

entries.title: Domestic violence assault charges: Francis Baillargeon Jr.
body: Francis Baillargeon Jr., 72, of North Pole is charged with assault in the fourth degree — recklessly causing physical injury to another person — a Class A misdemeanor; with violating his conditions of release on a misdemeanor charge, a Class B misdemeanor; and with unlawful contact in breach of a court order, a Class A misdemeanor. The assault count and the unlawful contact count are recorded by the court as domestic violence related.

Troopers say they responded to an address in North Pole for a reported domestic assault and that the investigation determined he had assaulted a former partner and violated his conditions of release. North Pole, Nov. 3 at about 2:21 p.m.; Alaska State Troopers, case AK26108887. He was taken to the Fairbanks Correctional Center.
The case was filed at Fairbanks on Nov. 4 and he was arraigned the same afternoon. Case 4FA-26-02227CR; pre-trial conference Dec. 24.

sources.label: Alaska State Troopers daily dispatch, Nov. 3

entries.title: Ten of twelve Wednesday hearings in Interior courts produced a result
body: Twelve open criminal cases in the Fairbanks, Nenana and Delta Junction courts carried a hearing calendared for Wednesday, Nov. 4. Ten of the twelve record a result.

Seven hearings were held: bail hearings in 4FA-26-02214CR, 4FA-26-00771CR and 4DJ-26-00022CR, and arraignments in 4FA-26-02128CR, 4FA-26-02111CR, 4FA-26-02110CR and 4FA-26-02114CR, which also had a bail hearing held. A bail hearing in 4FA-26-02199CR was continued, and arraignments in 4FA-26-02109CR and 4FA-26-02010CR were reset, each on a court notice rescheduling the hearing.

Two cases record no result. A jury trial set for 9:15 a.m. at the Fairbanks courthouse in a 2024 Delta Junction case, 4DJ-24-00006CR, carries a log entry for Wednesday and a further court date on Thursday. A status hearing set for 3:00 p.m. in a Nenana case, 4NE-24-00034CR, carries no result; the next date on that case is Nov. 9.

entries.title: Two Delta Junction case numbers in the court's filings report are not in its public database
body: Two criminal case numbers printed in the Alaska Court System's weekly criminal filings report, 4DJ-26-00067CR and 4DJ-26-00068CR, return “No Records Found” in CourtView, the court system's public case database.

The report lists each with one count recorded as a charging document pending or not filed, no degree of offense, and an offense location of Delta Junction. No offense or charge is stated on either number by any court record.
